title: Archival Compliance for Legal Consultations
business: A boutique legal firm specializing in high-stakes mediation.
problem: The firm generates thousands of hours of audio recordings from mediation sessions that remain trapped as unstructured binary files, making it impossible to perform cross-case discovery or verify verbal agreements without manual, time-consuming playback.
solution: By integrating WhisperKit-CoreML directly into the firm's internal macOS-based case management application, the firm can perform on-device speech-to-text transcription. This transforms audio archives into searchable, indexed text logs, ensuring that sensitive client data never leaves the local hardware while enabling instant keyword retrieval across historical case files.
steps: Integrate the WhisperKit-CoreML model assets into the local macOS application bundle.
Initialize the WhisperKit pipeline to point toward the local CoreML model files.
Stream recorded audio buffers into the transcription engine during background processing tasks.
Extract the resulting text segments and map them to specific case identifiers in the local database.
Implement a search interface that queries the generated text transcripts rather than the audio files.
outcome: Legal staff can instantly locate specific verbal commitments or testimony across years of mediation history, significantly reducing the labor required for case preparation and internal audits.
limitation: Because the model runs entirely on-device, transcription speed is strictly bound by the available Apple Silicon neural engine resources. If the system is under heavy load from other intensive tasks, transcription latency will increase, which can be monitored by tracking the time elapsed between audio ingestion and the availability of the text output.
